messages:
ella: quick sync — postmortem notes for 2026-03-10 missing spans + bad rollup. want explicit owners + dates so this isn't left open. link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-10-spans-agg
maria: thanks. main remediation buckets: 1) span sampling instrumentation, 2) correct rollup join keys, 3) targeted backfill for affected time ranges, 4) health-check + alerting, 5) CI/regression tests.
kevin: i'll take the rollup join key fix. root cause was nulls in the new service_id column causing partial-match joins. Estimate: 8 business days to PR + staged rollout.
ajay: i'll add a lightweight regression test in CI that compares rollup totals against raw spans for a small synthetic dataset. should be done in ~3 days.
ella: i'll own the backfill orchestration. plan: 1) dry-run on a snapshot, 2) rate-limited backfill windows (max 72h per job) to avoid DB saturation, 3) monitor long-tail ingestion. ETA dry-run 2d, phased backfill 10d.
sam: ops suggestion: create a recurring coverage sweep job that runs every 6 hours and writes metrics to observability. Cron: `0 */6 * * *`. Alert if span coverage drops > 15% vs 24h baseline.
ella: for safety, backfill job name: `infra.spans_backfill_v3`, include `--dry-run` flag and `--max-interval=72h`. will add throttling and retry logic.
maria: owners & timelines summary: kevin=rollup fix (8d), ella=backfill (2d dry-run / 10d phased), ajay=CI test (3d), maria=runbook+alerts (2d). confirm?
kevin: confirmed. i'll open PR today, include before/after aggregator metrics and a rollback gate.
ajay: confirmed. i'll push the CI pipeline change and mock dataset. will wire the failing test to block merges for rollup runway.
ops-bot: note: recent incidents with similar symptoms in 2025-10 and 2026-01 flagged as recurring pattern. Quarterly audit recommended.
maria: yes — add a quarterly audit calendar called "aggregator-key-assumptions-audit" and invite infra/eng-ml/observability. i'll own the audit checklist.
sam: ops runbook addition: post-deploy smoke should assert rollup_count >= 85% of expected for top 10 services over last 1h. if below threshold, trigger rollback and page oncall.
ella: i'll create the calendar event and the runbook PR. tagging infra and platform for review.
maria: i'll update the postmortem doc with these owners/times and mark items as P1. i'll also add the SQL we want in the alert.
ajay: quick SQL for alerting (to be added to runbook):
```
-- span coverage delta per service
SELECT service, sum(case when sampled then 1 else 0 end) as sampled_spans, count(*) as total_spans
FROM spans
WHERE ingested_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY service
HAVING (sum(case when sampled then 1 else 0 end)::float / nullif(count(*),0)) < 0.85;
```
kevin: i'll include a migration that backfills safe service_id defaults to avoid null-join cases. will coordinate with DB team.
maria: final: i'll add these to the remediation tracker and set weekly check-ins until closed. ping here if anyone slips. :thumbsup:
